summary: Wallbox N.V. files Form 6-K announcing court approval of its financial restructuring plan by the Commercial Court of Barcelona. The plan refinances approximately €169.6 million of outstanding financial debt and includes a capital increase. Following customary formalities, the plan becomes binding on all affected creditors and will implement a new capital structure. The restructuring aims to strengthen liquidity and support operational continuity while pursuing sustainable profitability. No transaction price per share, premium, or advisor is disclosed. Watch for effectiveness date and execution of the business plan; risk-arb focus is limited as this is a creditor-led reorganization.
